name: Oliver Hale
background: Augustus Hale's only son. Lives at the house, works nowhere in particular, and has been trying to persuade his father to sell the collection for two years.
motive: Owes a casino £22,000 and stands to inherit a garage full of money.
opportunity: Lives in the house and knows where every key is kept.
personality: Charming, bitter, quick to take offence.

relationships.note: Grew up with Tommy driving him to school.

name: Marco Ferri
background: Has restored and serviced every car in the Hale collection for fifteen years. Holds the roadster's spare key at his workshop.
motive: Hale owes him eight months of invoices.
opportunity: Knows the roadster better than its owner, and has a key.
personality: Warm, proud of his work, hot-tempered about money.
accessLevel: Spare key to the roadster (kept at the workshop)

relationships.note: Tells the chauffeur everything about the cars.

name: Thomas Reece
background: Six years as Augustus Hale's chauffeur and mechanic's mate. Lives over the coach house. Found the empty bay and raised the alarm.
motive: None anyone has noticed. The old man calls him 'the only honest man in the house'.
opportunity: Holds one of the two alarm codes and lives forty yards from the garage.
personality: Quiet, polite, devoted to the cars.

relationships.note: Drove Oliver to school every day for years.

name: Philippa Crowe
background: Senior assessor for classic cars. Revalued the roadster from £95,000 to £180,000 on Tuesday.
motive: A theft four days after doubling the valuation looks very convenient for someone.
opportunity: Walked round the garage and its alarm on Tuesday with a notebook.

name: Desmond Pryce
background: Owns the second-finest collection in Ridgeway, and two of the other three Castellane Sprints. Has offered to buy Hale's roadster five times.
motive: Told the whole Motor Club last month he'd 'have that car one way or another'.
opportunity: Knows the house, the garage and the family.
personality: Haughty, theatrical, wounded by any suggestion of vulgarity.

relationships.note: Old sparring partner at the club.
